English: Account sign-in (optional)
Chinese: 账号登录（可选）

English: Sign in with Manycore
Chinese: 使用 Manycore 登录

Chinese: 刷新账号会话

Chinese: 退出账号或取消登录

English: International account login is optional. Generation, history and rendering still require an API Key. Account login does not connect, replace or validate that Key.
Chinese: 国际站账号登录为可选项。生成、历史查询及渲染仍需要 API Key；账号登录不会连接、替换或验证 Key。

English: Account tokens stay in this background process only. Closing Rhino or resetting the process signs out. Signing out here clears this local account session; it does not revoke server tokens or disconnect your API Key.
Chinese: 账号令牌仅保留在当前后台进程内。关闭 Rhino 或重置进程会退出；此处退出只清除本机会话，不撤销服务端令牌，也不断开 API Key。

English: Waiting for browser sign-in
Chinese: 等待浏览器登录

English: Account session established
Chinese: 账号会话已建立

English: Account session expired
Chinese: 账号会话已过期

English: Refreshing account session
Chinese: 正在刷新账号会话

English: Account sign-in failed
Chinese: 账号登录失败

English: Account signed out
Chinese: 账号已退出

English: Account session expiry: {0}
Chinese: 账号会话有效期至：{0}

English: Account sign-in or refresh did not complete. Sign in again; API Key access is unchanged.
Chinese: 账号登录或刷新未完成，请重新登录；API Key 权限未改变。

English: Sign in before refreshing the account session.
Chinese: 请先登录账号，再刷新会话。

English: Include selected rectangular / point lights
Chinese: 包含选中的矩形灯/点灯

English: Point-light radius before block scaling (mm)
Chinese: 块缩放前的点灯半径（毫米）

English: Relative light intensity multiplier
Chinese: 相对灯光强度倍数

English: Point lights use the chosen sphere radius. Light intensity is relative, not calibrated to Rhino lumens. Unsupported selected lights fail before upload.
Chinese: 点灯使用所选球体半径。灯光强度为相对值，未与 Rhino 流明标定。不支持的选中灯光会在上传前报错。

English: Light radius and intensity multiplier must be positive numbers.
Chinese: 灯光半径和强度倍数必须为正数。

English: The document color preprocessing gamma is invalid.
Chinese: 文档的颜色预处理伽马值无效。

English: Select at least one supported mesh or surface together with the lights.
Chinese: 请在灯光之外，至少选中一个支持的网格或曲面。

English: Selected lights include an unsupported type. Only world rectangular and point lights are supported.
Chinese: 所选灯光含不支持的类型，目前支持世界坐标矩形灯和点灯。

English: Select meshes, surfaces, extrusions or mesh blocks and use a perspective view. Geometry, supported material constants, optional selected lights and camera will be uploaded.
Chinese: 请选中网格、曲面、挤出体或网格块，使用透视视图。将上传几何、支持的材质常量、可选的选中灯光及相机。

English: Offline rendering captures nested block placements and supported PBR constants. Textures, material graphs, glass transmission and GS ingestion are not converted yet. Results appear in Library.
Chinese: 离线渲染捕获嵌套块放置和支持的 PBR 常量。贴图、材质网络、玻璃透射及 GS 入库暂不转换；结果显示在资产库。

English: Material constants must be finite values from zero to one.
Chinese: 材质常量必须为零到一之间的有限值。

English: Only rectangular and spherical cloud lights are supported.
Chinese: 云端灯光仅支持矩形灯和球体灯。

English: Light pose must be a finite affine row-vector matrix.
Chinese: 灯光姿态必须是有限的仿射行向量矩阵。

English: Light pose must be rigid and right handed; dimensions carry its scale.
Chinese: 灯光姿态必须为右手刚体变换，缩放由尺寸表示。

English: Light color must contain three finite nonnegative linear values.
Chinese: 灯光颜色必须包含三个有限的非负线性值。

English: Light intensity must be finite and nonnegative.
Chinese: 灯光强度必须为有限非负值。

English: Light dimensions must be positive finite floats.
Chinese: 灯光尺寸必须是可表示为有限浮点数的正值。

English: A rectangular light needs a perpendicular nonzero direction.
Chinese: 矩形灯需要垂直于灯面的非零发光方向。

English: Sheared rectangular lights cannot be represented by RenderCloud.
Chinese: RenderCloud 无法表达剪切后的非矩形面灯。

English: Nonuniform or sheared point-light scaling is unsupported.
Chinese: 不支持点灯的非均匀缩放或剪切。

English: Cannot compute valid mesh normals. Repair the selected mesh before rendering.
Chinese: 无法计算有效的网格法线。请修复所选网格后再渲染。

English: Include direct base-color bitmaps (mesh UVs / sRGB PNG or JPEG)
Chinese: 包含直接基色贴图（网格 UV / sRGB PNG 或 JPEG）

English: Offline rendering preserves smooth normals, supported PBR constants and direct mesh UV bitmaps. Complex texture mapping, material graphs, glass transmission and GS ingestion are not converted. Disable bitmap export to use material constants only.
Chinese: 离线渲染保留平滑法线、支持的 PBR 常量和直接网格 UV 位图。暂不转换复杂纹理映射、材质网络、玻璃透射和 GS 入库；关闭位图导出可仅使用材质常量。

English: This bitmap uses unsupported mapping, blending or color space. Use a directly textured mesh with existing UVs, or disable bitmap export.
Chinese: 此位图使用了尚不支持的映射、混合或色彩空间。请使用已有 UV 的直接贴图网格，或关闭位图导出。

English: The bitmap path is unresolved. Save the document with local bitmap files or disable bitmap export.
Chinese: 位图路径未解析。请保存文档并使用本地位图文件，或关闭位图导出。

English: A base-color bitmap file is missing. Relink the local bitmap in Rhino or disable bitmap export.
Chinese: 基色位图文件缺失。请在 Rhino 中重新关联本地位图，或关闭位图导出。

English: Base-color bitmaps must be local files, not URLs or network shares.
Chinese: 基色位图必须为本地文件，不能使用网址或网络共享路径。

English: A texture changed while preparing the render. Capture the selection again.
Chinese: 准备渲染时贴图发生了变化。请重新捕获所选对象。

English: The encoded bitmap exceeds the runtime byte-array capacity.
Chinese: 编码位图超出运行时字节数组容量。

English: The base-color bitmap must be a structurally valid 8-bit RGB JPEG or RGB/RGBA PNG.
Chinese: 基色位图必须为结构有效的 8 位 RGB JPEG 或 RGB/RGBA PNG。

English: PNG color-key transparency is unsupported. Use an 8-bit RGB or RGBA PNG.
Chinese: 暂不支持 PNG 色键透明。请使用 8 位 RGB 或 RGBA PNG。

English: An RGBA bitmap with ignored texture alpha cannot be combined with partial material opacity yet. Use an RGB bitmap or disable bitmap export.
Chinese: 暂不支持在忽略贴图 alpha 时叠加半透明材质。请使用 RGB 位图，或关闭位图导出。

English: Embedded color profiles, non-sRGB declarations and EXIF metadata are unsupported. Export an untagged sRGB PNG/JPEG or disable bitmap export.
Chinese: 暂不支持内嵌色彩配置、非 sRGB 声明和 EXIF 元数据。请导出无标签的 sRGB PNG/JPEG，或关闭位图导出。

English: Scene settings
Chinese: 场景设置

English: Capture selected rectangular / point lights at start
Chinese: 开始时捕获选中的矩形灯/点灯

English: Apply scene settings
Chinese: 应用场景设置

English: Save scene settings
Chinese: 保存场景设置

English: Model X / Y / Z offset (mm)
Chinese: 模型 X / Y / Z 偏移（毫米）

English: Model scale
Chinese: 模型比例

English: Model rotation around Z (degrees)
Chinese: 模型绕 Z 轴旋转（度）

English: Environment brightness multiplier
Chinese: 环境亮度倍数

English: Captured light intensity multiplier
Chinese: 已捕获灯光的强度倍数

English: Captured lights: {0}. Positions and dimensions stay at the start snapshot; intensity can change.
Chinese: 已捕获灯光：{0}。位置和尺寸保持开始时的快照，可调整强度。

English: Scene settings affect the cloud preview only. The Rhino document is unchanged.
Chinese: 场景设置只影响云预览，不改动 Rhino 文档。

English: Enter finite scene values; scale, environment and radius must be positive, and light intensity cannot be negative.
Chinese: 请输入有限数值；比例、环境亮度和半径必须大于零，灯光强度不能为负数。

English: The preview changed while editing. Open scene settings again.
Chinese: 编辑期间预览发生变化，请重新打开场景设置。

English: Scene adjustments acknowledged {0} / {1}; image arrival is not an acknowledgement.
Chinese: 场景调整已确认 {0} / {1}；收到图像不代表调整已确认。

English: Select enabled rectangular or point lights, or turn off light capture in scene settings.
Chinese: 请选择已启用的矩形灯或点灯，或在场景设置中关闭灯光捕获。

English: Wait for the previous scene adjustment to be acknowledged before applying another.
Chinese: 请等待前一次场景调整确认后，再应用新的调整。

English: Model placement must be finite with a positive scale.
Chinese: 模型位置必须为有限数值，比例必须大于零。

English: Scene edits must retain the original light slots and types.
Chinese: 场景调整必须保留原始灯光位置编号和类型。

English: The 3MF package is invalid or contains unresolved or external resources.
Chinese: 3MF 包无效，或包含缺失资源或包外引用。

English: This 3MF uses extensions not yet supported by mesh placement. Export a core 3MF or static GLB instead.
Chinese: 此 3MF 使用了网格放置尚未支持的扩展。请导出为核心 3MF 或静态 GLB。

English: Export selected meshes to USD
Chinese: 将选中网格导出为 USD

English: USD output file
Chinese: USD 输出文件

English: Export selected mesh USD
Chinese: 导出选中网格 USD

English: Include direct base-color bitmaps in mesh USD
Chinese: 网格 USD 包含直接基础色贴图

English:
Exported {0:N0} mesh parts and {1:N0} triangles to USD.
{2}
Chinese:
已导出 {0:N0} 个网格部分、{1:N0} 个三角面到 USD。
{2}

English: Keep this texture folder beside the USD file: {0}
Chinese: 请将此贴图文件夹与 USD 文件一起保留：{0}

English: USD texture filtering is viewer-defined; source filter settings are retained as metadata.
Chinese: USD 贴图过滤由查看器决定；原始过滤设置保留在元数据中。

English: Exporting the captured selection locally. Use AholoCancel to stop. No cloud request is made.
Chinese: 正在本地导出捕获的选中对象。使用 AholoCancel 停止，不调用云服务。

English: Local export cancelled. The previous output was preserved.
Chinese: 本地导出已取消，原有输出文件保留。

English: Select meshes, surfaces, extrusions or ordinary blocks first.
Chinese: 请先选中网格、曲面、拉伸体或普通块。

English: Select model-space geometry. Page-space objects use different units and cannot enter this mesh workflow.
Chinese: 请选择模型空间几何。页面空间对象使用不同单位，不能进入此网格流程。
